featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

With the low-profile point-to-point EX-40-G3 extender set, it’s never been easier to extend full 1080p HD video over a Cat6 cable; HD audio is also supported. Plus, IR source control and PoC (Power-over-Cable) all wrapped up in a compact chassis for unbeatable value, reliability and ease of installation.
WyreStorm’s newly designed 40 meter extender, the EX-40-G3, is now smaller than ever. With almost half the width of its predecessor, this makes the G3 lighter in weight and easier to keep discreet.

Size isn’t the only upgrade found in the newly designed 40 meter extender. The G3 now includes Power over Cable abilities, saving the installer time and headache from having to supply local power discreetly to the receiver. But don’t fret if PoC isn’t available, as the receiver is capable of accepting local power.
With features such as PoC, automatic EDID, long cable mode capability and IR source control, the EX-40-G3 brings a tremendous amount of features to any simple installation at a cost effective price.
